items.prompt: What changes in the require_sum_cents adapter?

options.text: The throwing wrapper recomputes the sum with a different overflow threshold
options.why: It calls the same checked_sum_cents core and changes only how its declared errors are reported.

options.text: Overflow becomes defined modular signed arithmetic
options.why: The guarded core still rejects it.

options.text: All persistent business effects become atomic
options.why: C++ exception policy does not prove that outcome.

options.text: Typed core failures become documented exceptions
options.why: The arithmetic validation and successful values are shared.

items.explanation: The wrapper changes outward error signaling, not the core units/range or durable state capability.
